modify_order_reasons.Void: Still within the void window, full cancel — automation voids ticket + EMD and removes segment (full cancel only)
modify_order_reasons.24h airline rule: Within the airline's 24h window per Edvin Documents — not always a full refund, check calculator
modify_order_reasons.24H BR Cancellation: Brazil law — full refund with no handling fee even if airline does not allow 24h, provided departure is >=7 days after purchase
modify_order_reasons.Ticket rules - airline fee: Voluntary cancellation per fare rules + penalty
modify_order_reasons.Ticket rules - taxes: Tax-only refund — split first if only some passengers
modify_order_reasons.Failed Flex Rebooking: Flex rebooking could not be fulfilled — refund penalty/air amount already collected
modify_order_reasons.Force majeure - refund: FM eligible — usually no ETG service fee
modify_order_reasons.NACO: Claim old ticket value to keep as ETG credit toward new ticket — no payout to customer

coupon_status_actions.A - Airport Control: May still be reissuable — proceed cautiously with Manual pricing, verify with Edvin first
coupon_status_actions.C - Checked in: Ask the airline (YY) to open the ticket before reissue is possible
coupon_status_actions.E - Exchanged: Check whether a new ticket already exists for this passenger before doing anything else
coupon_status_actions.F - Flown/Used: No reissue possible on this coupon
coupon_status_actions.L - Lifted/Boarded: No reissue possible on this coupon
coupon_status_actions.S - Suspended: Possible to ask the airline (YY) to open the ticket for reissue via Support queue
coupon_status_actions.U - Unknown segment: Possible to ask the airline (YY) to open the ticket for reissue
coupon_status_actions.V - Voided: Ticket already voided — proceed with New Ticket Sell instead of rebooking
coupon_status_actions.O - Open: Ready for rebooking/refund via ATC or Manual

sabre_commands_quickref.WETR*[line] or WETR*T[ticket]: Open ticket, read STAT (coupon status) and BAG
sabre_commands_quickref.AAA[PCC]: Switch to a different PCC (must match ticket-issuing office for WFRF)
sabre_commands_quickref.WFRFTR[line]¥A[YY]¥N[pax].1¥S[segments]: ATC reissue/reprice + create TST (add ¥NCB, ¥BR[fare family], etc.)
sabre_commands_quickref.WFRTR[line]¥A[YY]¥N[pax].1¥S[segments]: Manual reprice for partially-used ticket (1 pax per run)
sabre_commands_quickref.MD: Read old tax breakdown on ticket
sabre_commands_quickref.*PQ / *PQS / PQD / PQDALL: Check / view all / delete stored fare quote(s)
sabre_commands_quickref.FQ[issue date][city pair][departure date: Retrieve fare/fare rules for manual pricing
sabre_commands_quickref.WFRA[ticket]/REF or WFRATR[line]/REF: Confirm Automated Refund (voluntary, Sabre-issued ticket only)

service_fee_rules.schedule_change_second_alt: 15 EUR/pax (Basic tier only; free for B.com/Platinum/Business)
service_fee_rules.multi_pnr_rule: Charge service fee once per person/order — NEVER once per PNR. Charge the highest applicable fee if mixed.

open_questions_notes: SC Trivial: Automation may not auto-process trivial under 30m; FL can manually accept TK->HK if customer agrees.
LCC/Portal ancillary <48h: strictly refer to airline airport desk.
Partially used Sabre syntax: WFRTR[line]¥A[YY]¥N[pax].1¥S[seg] (1 pax per run).
Sabre partial EMD: Sabre lacks coupon selection for EMD; use BSP Refund Application (RA) or escalate to Refunds.
